title: Nuevo Laredo Gears Up for El Buen Fin, Nov. 13–17, With Focus on Local Shops

content:
Nuevo Laredo is getting ready for the cheapest shopping week of the year. The city's Chamber of Commerce, Canaco, announced that the El Buen Fin program will run from Nov. 13 to Nov. 17, with the kickoff at Plaza Paseo Monterrey, on Avenida Monterrey and Municipio Libre.

Businesses that want to take part must register online through the Chamber's platform at buenfin.com — not at the Chamber's offices — and registration is already open. Former Canaco president Eliud Ciénega Jurado said at the announcement press conference that businesses should register on time, with their logo, so they can start promoting their deals.

Built for local business

The goal this year, Chamber leaders said, is to support local commerce and the city's micro and small businesses — to let residents know what shops exist in the city, and to let those shops move merchandise that has been sitting unsold for lack of buyers.

Shoppers were advised to plan their money ahead of time so they can take advantage of the offers during the week. Ciénega stressed that buyers should not forget the real point of the program: strengthening local commerce and helping businesses recapitalize by selling products that have been stuck on shelves.

Another stated goal is to bring informal businesses closer to the Chamber so they can join the formal economy and gain the benefits that come with it.

El Buen Fin began in Nuevo Laredo through the Chamber of Commerce as a local answer to Black Friday in the United States, which falls on Nov. 27 this year, the day after Thanksgiving. What started as a counterweight to cross-border shopping has become a fixture of the city's commercial calendar in its own right.

For Laredo shoppers who cross regularly, the dates matter too: the deals on the Mexican side land a full ten days before Black Friday, and the program's focus on small local shops means the bargains are not only at the big chains.
